# M3a Wikipedia extraction pilot (auto-generated by `python -m scout.text.wiki_run`)

Commit `d6b415f`, model `claude-haiku-5-5`, prompt `extract-v2`, year rule `context-year`, batch `msgbatch_01LETQtjGT69jhX76esB7sw5`. Text from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0); each example links to the exact diff it came from.

- Documents: 100 submitted, 100 succeeded
- Tokens: 146,628 in / 15,237 out (mean 1,466 / 152 per doc); cost **$0.01** (Batch API)
- Events returned: 179; kept after verification: **46**
- Dropped by reason: {'no_quote': 0, 'bad_date': 1, 'year_only': 37, 'outside_window': 93, 'date_not_in_text': 2, 'bad_type': 0}
- Kept by type: {'transfer': 21, 'loan': 12, 'contract_extension': 10, 'injury': 2, 'contract_expiry': 1}

**Full-run estimate:** ~23,764 non-empty documents (all labelled player-years with an English Wikipedia page × the non-empty share in this sample) × measured mean tokens = **$2.65** on the Batch API.

**Sample spread** (documents per snapshot year): 2013: 9, 2014: 11, 2015: 7, 2016: 7, 2017: 6, 2018: 15, 2019: 9, 2020: 10, 2021: 6, 2022: 2, 2023: 6, 2024: 12

## Yield per player-year

| Events | Kept | Per player-year |
|---|---|---|
| injury | 2 | 0.02 |
| contract (extension + expiry) | 11 | 0.11 |
| move (transfer + loan) | 33 | 0.33 |
| all | 46 | 0.46 |

## Moves vs Transfermarkt transfers

- Scored on players with at least one recorded transfer; 14 extracted moves of players with none were left out (coverage gap in the table, not an extraction error)
- Precision: 19 of 19 extracted transfers/loans match a recorded move within 31 days = 100% (95% CI 83%–100%)
- Recall: 21 of 32 recorded senior moves in the windows were extracted = 66% (95% CI 48%–80%) (bounded: documents hold only text added during the year)
